observations.text: LibTV is a separate origin (www.liblib.tv) reached from liblib.art via the nav pill 前往LibTV创作. Its <title> is 'LibTV - 专业视频创作工具'. Auth is bridged across the two origins with an iframe cross-storage-hub.html (liblib.art ↔ liblib.tv) — the header can render 注册/登录 before hydration while the canvas shows the logged-in user.

The 'professional tool entry' is a home page of template launchers + a persistent Agent composer; every launcher resolves to the same /canvas surface (new or cloned project). There is no separate professional-tool page, modal or mode — the canvas IS the professional tool and templates parametrize it.

Home feed 'TV Show' lists published projects with author, badge (先锋), title; each exposes 查看创作过程 which opens the full node graph read-only with 复制项目 — the community→creation loop is 'publish process → viewer copies project into own workspace'.
Recent projects appear on home (最近项目) rather than a dedicated /projects route; the sidebar 项目 item did not change the URL in our session.
Sidebar entry LibTV Agent navigates to /skill (skill marketplace + composer).
创作者挑战赛 and Blender 插件 clicks produced no in-page change (probably external / new tab).
